heapOrArchives.title: Custodial Position
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If successful, access two additional cards from R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Inside Job
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: Hammer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break wall subroutine. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you break a wall subroutine with Hammer, lose a total of [2] from stealth cards.

ice.title: Data Darts
ice.rulesText:
[Subroutine] Do 3 net damage.
[Subroutine] The Runner cannot break any subroutines of the next piece of ice encountered during this run.
